name: All Quiet
summary: All Quiet charges $4.99 per user a month on Standard and $9.99 on Pro, billed monthly, with a 14-day trial and no free plan. SMS and phone alerts carry no per-message charge, and status pages start on Pro.

facts.text: Escalation tiers re-route automatically when an alert goes unacknowledged, and the example on the product page escalates after 10 minutes.
Standard includes unlimited on-call schedules, escalation policies and overrides, and retains incidents for 6 months, against 12 months on Pro.
The FAQ says there are no per-channel or per-message charges, though status page SMS subscribers are listed as custom with no price.
Data is hosted in Frankfurt for EU customers or US-East 1 for US customers, and All Quiet says it is not HIPAA compliant.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Billed monthly. SSO, 6 months of incident retention

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Billed monthly. Adds OIDC, SCIM, status pages and 12 months of retention
